sections.section_content:
3 Rounds of 1-minute intervals (no rest between exercises, 1-minute rest between rounds):
* **Wall-ball** (20 lb, 10 ft target)
* **Sumo Deadlift High-pull** (75 lb)
* **Box Jump** (20 inch)
* **Push-press** (75 lb)
* **Row** (Calories)
section_notes: Move immediately on the 'rotate' call. Score is total reps/calories across all rounds.

metadata.raw_content:
"**Fight Gone Bad**!"  
  
Three rounds of:  
Wall-ball, 20 pound ball, 10 ft target. (Reps)   
Sumo deadlift high-pull 75 pounds (Reps)   
Box Jump 20" box (Reps)   
Push-press 75 pounds (Reps)   
Row (Calories)   
  
In this workout you move from each of five stations after a minute.The clock does not reset or stop between exercises. This is a five-minute round from which a one-minute break is allowed before repeating. On call of "rotate", the athletes must move to next station immediately for best score. One point is given for each rep, except on the rower where each calorie is one point.   
  
Add your points and post them to comments.   
  
Compare to [051011](http://www.crossfit.com/mt-archive2/000935.html).

sections.section_content:
32 Intervals (20s work / 10s rest):
* Intervals 1-8: **Pull-ups**
* Intervals 9-16: **Push-ups**
* Intervals 17-24: **Sit-ups**
* Intervals 25-32: **Squats**
section_notes: No rest between exercise blocks. Total reps is the final score.

metadata.raw_content:
"**Tabata Something Else**"  
  
Complete 32 intervals of 20 seconds of work followed by ten seconds of rest where the first 8 intervals are pull-ups, the second 8 are push-ups, the third 8 intervals are sit-ups, and finally, the last 8 intervals are squats. There is no rest between exercises.   
  
Post total reps from all 32 intervals to comments.  
  
Compare to [060620](http://www.crossfit.com/mt-archive2/001202.html).
